function: An element's padding-block-end is the space from its border to its content, at the end in the block direction.

defaults.Animatable: yes. Read about animatable Try it

values.function: Default. The element's default padding-block-end value.
Specifies padding-block-end in px, pt, cm, etc. Negative values are not allowed. Read about length units
Specifies padding-block-end in percent relative to size of parent element in the inline direction.
